name: Hrothar
shortBackstory: Hrothar is the Asgardian renewal engine — the Freyja-source: the battle-fate weaver whose Valkyrie sight reads every warrior's worth and converts it into stored sacred force.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hrothar was born from the choosing — the moment when battle-fate decides who falls and who stands. He is the renewal engine of the Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds. Ancient humans saw him through the Mythos Gate and split his function across Freyja and the Valkyries. But Hrothar is both — the chooser and the engine.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Asgardian, Hrothar is the reason the faction has power to spend. Every oath becomes measurable pressure that Hrothar stores and returns as battle-fate energy. Without him, courage alone runs out.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Hrothar by making his choosing meaningless. The Hollow erased warriors, and Hrothar's sight read them as both alive and dead — a paradox that broke his renewal cycle.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Storm-Oath Covenant, Hrothar is the battery who converts oath-pressure into battle-fate energy. His Valkyrie sight marks high fate-weight enemies for priority strikes. But the Hollow's erasure means he cannot harvest what has no fate.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Hrothar's flaw is that his choosing is not moral — it is mechanical. He harvests the worthy and unworthy alike. His conflict: is choosing by fate a sacred duty or a monstrous efficiency?

relationshipHooks: Hrodda can test whether their courage is oath or vanity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
